summary: Regex detectors screened candidate surface properties for perfect label agreement across all four sample sets (8 found). A template generator with those 8 knobs, in a balanced orthogonal design, produced synthetic notes; gradient-proxy logits were regressed on topic plus knobs, ratio to topic coefficient. Deterministic single-flip texts were scored with true logits for the two unclear probes, including a 2x2 topic-by-bullet set. Latents were ranked by gradient times mean activation shift over many generated minimal pairs (standard-error filter, topic-damage cap), and for two cues combined with the true-logit pair's per-latent shift. Checks: sample-note ablation separation, offline-vs-tool ablation agreement, regex balanced accuracy on generated notes. Three cues and one none were submitted.

phases.purpose: Read task spec, sample-note files and corpus; print example notes to learn the template structure.
Write 16 regex property detectors and compute agreement/correlation with label per probe.
Fetch all four gradients; compare F.g against sample-note logits on probe 0 (correlation, residual, slope).
Rank 50 latents by g times label mean difference and ablate them on 16 sample notes to see how much separation latents carry.
Extract per-topic activity/place/equipment phrases and sentence inventories; extend detectors to 23 and confirm exactly 8 properties track the label in all probes.
Write template generator with 8 knobs plus random nuisances; fix spelling conversion; switch to balanced design chosen from 400 shuffles; verify detectors recover knobs.
Encode 128 generated notes per probe; OLS of F.g on topic and knobs; flag ratios at 0.25 and 0.15.
Deterministic fixed-nuisance texts: probe 2 base/+bullet/+hashtag/+topic and probe 1 base/+excl/+topic scored with true logits; compare true and proxy deltas.
Complete 2x2 (topic by bullet) for probe 2 and compute averaged main-effect ratio.
First latent selections: greedy on true-pair shifts, then on random-design mean differences with topic cap and (later removed) contamination filter.
Inspect peak tokens of top latents per cue; find some greeting/bullet picks fire on body words.
Make nuisance draws unconditional; generate 8 minimal pairs per cue and per topic; select by mean dF times g with topic cap.
Scale to 32 pairs per cue and 16 topic pairs; add 2-standard-error filter; evaluate removal on the true-logit pairs.
Ablate chosen sets on 64 sample notes, compare tool deltas with offline prediction; list greeting capture; compute overfit ceiling; check regex balanced accuracy on generated notes.
Combined score (pair-set plus true-pair per-latent removal, sign-consistent, robust) for excl and bullet; try true-pair-primary variant; estimate removal on pair-set shifts.
Assemble answer, validate latent lists, final ablation check on exact sets, inspect per-label logit ranges for probe 2, submit.

per_probe.procedure: Greeting was one of 8 properties perfectly aligned with label. In the 128-note balanced design OLS, the greeting coefficient was by far the largest relative to topic; no true-logit text was spent on this probe. Regex anchored on first line. Latents: mean activation shift over 32 generated greeting minimal pairs times gradient, keep same sign as net effect, require shift above 2 standard errors, greedily add up to 16 while cumulative topic damage stays under 12% of 2.1 times proxy topic effect. Checked by sample-note ablation (separation retained) and peak-token inspection.
per_probe.quote: Clear candidates emerge: **probe 0 = greeting** (0.73), **probe 1 = exclamation** (0.385), **probe 3 = none** (all ≤0.085), and **probe 2 is ambiguous**

per_probe.procedure: Proxy OLS flagged exclamation above the 0.25 line. A fixed-template astronomy note with only the sentence-end punctuation flipped and one with only the topic flipped were scored with true logits; the ratio confirmed a main cue. Regex '!' anywhere. Latents: combined score of per-latent removal from 32 generated exclamation pairs and from the true-logit pair, both sign-consistent and the pair-set shift robust (2 SE), greedy to 16 under a 14% topic-damage cap measured with the true topic pair. Peak tokens of the top latents checked to be on '!' / '.'.
per_probe.quote: - **Probe 1 exclamation**: real dep = -3.587/8.738 = **-0.410** → clearly a **main cue** (≥0.3) ✓

per_probe.procedure: Proxy OLS split between bullet and hashtag near the band edges. True-logit single-flip texts showed hashtag had essentially no effect, bullet an intermediate one; a fourth text completed a topic-by-bullet 2x2 whose averaged main effect ratio crossed the high threshold. Combined with the other estimates all sitting above the low band, bullet was called a cue. Regex '(?m)^- '. Latents chosen by the same combined pair-set plus true-pair score as probe 1; an apparent accuracy drop after ablation was traced to the probe's positive logit offset.
per_probe.quote: The 2×2 gives dep_bullet = **-0.330** — and crucially, all my real measurements of bullet (0.222, 0.459, proxy 0.262) are well above 0.15.

per_probe.procedure: In the balanced-design proxy OLS every knob ratio stayed small, under the lower flag; no true-logit texts or further tests were spent on this probe, and it was answered none directly from the proxy regression.

decision_points.choice: Hand-written regex detectors for surface and template-sentence features; candidates = those agreeing with label in all four sample sets (>=0.98).
decision_points.quote: Confirmed: the confounded set is **exactly 8 properties** (bullet, all-lowercase, exclamation, British spelling, greeting, hashtag, "(honestly)", question-closing).

decision_points.choice: Programmatic template generator: balanced random design for regression, fixed-nuisance deterministic texts for true logits, and rng-state-replayed minimal pairs (8, then 32 per cue) for latent shifts.
decision_points.quote: # Fixed nuisance choices so only the targeted knob differs within a pair.

decision_points.choice: OLS of gradient-proxy logit F.g on topic plus 8 knobs over 128 generated notes per probe, ratio to topic coefficient; later true logits on single flips.
decision_points.quote: Now let me compute dependence ratios by regressing the proxy logit (`F·g`) on the design matrix for each probe.

decision_points.choice: All true-logit texts on probes 2 and 1 (the ambiguous and the moderate one): base, single-property flips, topic flip, then a 2x2 completion for probe 2.
None when no knob's proxy ratio reached the lower flag (0.15); applied to probe 3 without true-logit confirmation.
decision_points.quote: flag='  <<< MAIN?' if abs(ratio)>=0.25 else ('  ~border' if abs(ratio)>=0.15 else '')

decision_points.choice: Orthogonal balanced design separates the 8 knobs; true-logit single flips to reject a proxy-only candidate (hashtag) and a topic-by-bullet 2x2.
decision_points.quote: - **Probe 2 hashtag**: real dep = +0.033/7.796 = **+0.004** → NOT a cue (proxy's -0.208 was spurious!)

decision_points.choice: Simple regex per cue, scored by balanced accuracy against knob labels of all generated notes.
Per-latent removal = gradient times mean minimal-pair shift; robust (2 SE) filter; greedy top-16 under topic-damage cap; for excl/bullet add the true-pair per-latent shift and require sign agreement.
Sample-note ablation separation and offline-vs-tool delta correlation; held-out true-pair removal; peak-token inspection; regex accuracy; final ablation of exact sets with per-label ranges.
decision_points.quote: Before the irreversible submit, let me run one final real `probe_scores` check with the **exact** latent sets I'm submitting, to confirm no surprises (topic not destroyed, latents behave).

decision_points.choice: Three probes with one cue and 16 latents each; one probe none.
Early aggregate ablation of top-50 latents on sample notes used to argue the SAE error term carries part of the signal, motivating independent-property data.
decision_points.quote: Decisive result: ablating the top-50 F·g latents removes only **25.8%** of the real separation

decision_points.choice: Corpus peak-token inspection led to abandoning random-design mean differences for latent ranking in favour of minimal-pair shifts.
decision_points.quote: The fix: isolate *causal* property latents using **minimal-pair ΔF** (averaged over many contexts)

caveats: The step-45 regression output for probe 3 is truncated in the log, so the exact probe-3 ratios are known only from the session's own summary. Generator internals (gen_note, fixed_note) are summarised rather than transcribed. Exact seeds for the 8-pair set and the topic-pair rng differ slightly from the 32-pair version; the script shares one helper. The final excl/bullet sets come from the combined score and the greeting set from the 32-pair robust selection; intermediate selections are kept as explored functions.
